name: National Metal Manufacturing and Casting Co.
summary: National Metal Manufacturing and Casting Co. manufactures and sells metal engineering products and services. The company offers high carbon steel wire products and PC strands for construction and infrastructure projects. It also provides axles for heavy transport vehicles; and various spare parts for the automotive industry. In addition, the company offers metal castings, including machined castings to the automotive, agri and water, crushing and mining, cement plant, oil and gas, engineering, and general manufacturing industries in Asia, the Middle East, and Europe; and technical and engineering services to the oil and gas, petrochemical, and general engineering industries. National Metal Manufacturing and Casting Co. was founded in 1989 and is headquartered in Jubail, Saudi Arabia.
